desc_zh: 显示潜在流动性聚集区，辅助更精确的入场与止损布置。
desc_en: Highlights liquidity clusters for more precise entries and risk placement.
usage_zh: 安装后在任意图表启用，通过参数调节阈值与显示范围。建议与结构分析搭配。
usage_en: Enable on any chart and tune thresholds/range. Use alongside structure analysis.

desc_zh: 伦敦/纽约/亚洲 session 重叠可视化，帮助选择更有效的交易窗口。
desc_en: Visualizes London/NY/Asia sessions and overlaps for better timing.
usage_zh: 在图表角落显示当前时段状态与剩余时间，可自定义时区。
usage_en: Shows current session and countdown; timezone configurable.
